description:
Chinggis Khan, also known as Ghenghis Khan's, early years on the Mongolian Steppe are recounted, including his family’s fall from power, survival against rival tribes, rescuing of his first wife, Börte, and alliances as a young warrior. It all lays the groundwork to turn a young boy, Temujin, into the founder and first khan of the Mongol Empire.
